newsitem.title: USA: AT&T Chairman Allen has successful heart surgery.
newsitem.headline: AT&T Chairman Allen has successful heart surgery.

text.p: Robert Allen, chairman of AT&T Corp., underwent successful heart surgery Thursday at the Mayo Clinic in Rochester, Minn., the company said.
Allen, 62, was resting "comfortably" following surgery to replace his aortic valve, correcting a congenital condition, it said.
"The surgery was entirely elective and had been scheduled for several months," AT&T said. "His doctors do not anticipate he will have any physical restrictions."
The company said Allen had known about his condition "for decades" and decided to undergo surgery after a recent physical examination showed a slight constriction of his aortic valve.
